_comment: Splitting one TripleA region into several aaa.gdf territories.
Each entry maps a TripleA polygon name to a set of aaa.gdf names, each with
one or more anchor points in TripleA canvas coordinates (3500x2000, y down).
The region is partitioned by nearest anchor and the cells are unioned per
name, so a territory can claim several disjoint lobes by taking several
anchors, and thin strips (Chile) are produced by placing anchors along them.
Anchors are authored against tools/mapgen/render_splits.py output. Adjust an
anchor and re-render; there are no cut lines to keep consistent.
